categories.main_business_segments: KOATSU GAS KOGYO operates three main business segments: Gas Business (manufacture and sale of various high-pressure gases, gas-related equipment, and materials), Chemical Products Business (manufacture and sale of adhesives, paints, and related materials), and Other Business (including IT solutions such as LSI cards and electronic paper products, as well as food additives and overseas sales).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced gas production technologies, including the manufacture of dissolved acetylene, oxygen, nitrogen, argon, and specialty gases, as well as the development of high-pressure gas supply systems. In the chemical segment, it focuses on synthetic resin-based adhesives and environmentally friendly water-based paints, with ongoing R&D in new applications and production methods such as biomass materials and carbon recycling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include companies in the construction, steel, shipbuilding, machinery, automotive, electronics, and food industries. The gas business serves industrial and medical sectors, while the chemical segment targets paper, woodworking, construction, automotive, electronics, and healthcare markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Japan, with a nationwide network of manufacturing and sales bases. It also has a growing presence in Asia, particularly Vietnam, where it manufactures and sells gases, adhesives, and paints, and is expanding further into the broader Asian region.
categories.supply_chain_position: KOATSU GAS KOGYO is positioned both upstream and midstream, as a manufacturer and supplier of industrial gases, chemical products, and related equipment, as well as a distributor and logistics provider through its group companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening profitability through operational efficiency, expanding into growth markets (such as hydrogen, ammonia, and environmentally friendly products), and enhancing R&D in new gas applications, carbon-neutral technologies, and high-value-added chemical products. The company is also focused on sustainability, digital transformation, and global expansion, especially in Asia.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales (gases, adhesives, paints, equipment), equipment leasing, and related services. It also earns income from logistics, IT solutions, and overseas sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include large industrial gas and chemical companies such as Nippon Sanso Holdings, Air Water, and Denka. KOATSU GAS KOGYO holds a strong domestic share in dissolved acetylene and differentiates itself through its integrated supply chain, regional focus, and product diversification.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 98.3 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.97 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 4.78 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profits over the past five years, with a stable financial base and ongoing investments in facilities and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KOATSU GAS KOGYO emphasizes safety, reliability, and environmental responsibility, offering high-quality, high-share products such as dissolved acetylene and innovative, eco-friendly adhesives and paints. Its value proposition includes integrated manufacturing, logistics, and sales, strong regional networks, and a commitment to sustainability and customer-specific solutions.
